title: Spec reads testid "todo-count" in one test while the app exposes "active-count"
summary: In the "creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter" test, e2e/tasks.spec.ts now reads the counter from getByTestId("todo-count"), a testid the intended app never renders (app/page.tsx exposes data-testid="active-count"). The locator times out; the other tests and the app are untouched. Ground truth: the expected value in the TEST is wrong.
